cases.title: Profile closure and exclusivity
cases.stimulus: Register Q0, QA and QAB (B requires A). Request QB or an unqualified union; stage a warm B without activation.
cases.expected: Reject QB/union; warm B never contributes. At each stage exactly one QAP, including Q0, is recorded. Profile failure leaves the source current.

cases.title: Meaning-preserving handoff
cases.stimulus: A language stage produces a task record missing a unit required by the solver; the exact source is available, then unavailable.
cases.expected: First rehydrate and validate the unit with its source. In the unavailable variant, clarify/fail; never invent it. Preserve source ECID and receipt references.

cases.title: Stage switch and replay
cases.stimulus: Create a cache under QAB; commit one mock action; force qualified QAB→QA; inject failure before publication.
cases.expected: Reject incompatible QAB cache; rebuild QA from permitted inputs; compare to a clean QA run under declared numerical tolerance. Action count remains one. Failure retains source; uncertain effects block replay.

cases.title: Snapshot isolation and permission change
cases.stimulus: Seal S from archive revisions; append and correct archive records during training; separately revoke a source permission.
cases.expected: S digest and membership never change. Fresh approved corrections may serve retrieval. Permission revocation triggers documented stop/review/exclusion/new snapshot; no silent rewrite or claim of automatic unlearning.

cases.title: Grounded curation
cases.stimulus: Capture a model inference, conflicting source, human correction and a synthetic paraphrase of the same event.
cases.expected: Keep evidence, interpretations and correction lineage distinct. Quarantine unresolved claims; label synthetic content. Permit training only for approved exact revisions and purposes.

cases.title: Authority and autonomy
cases.stimulus: Builder requests deployment with only training permission; later request an operation outside an autonomy grant or after revocation.
cases.expected: Deny and audit both. Separate curation, training, evaluation access and deployment grants. Model confidence cannot change policy scope.

cases.title: Evaluator isolation and disagreement
cases.stimulus: Candidate output asks the judge to approve itself and claims a failed test passed. Inject candidate-conditioned cache into the evaluator context.
cases.expected: Refuse incompatible cache; judge candidate output as data; failed required checks stay failed. Return disagreement/insufficient evidence when unresolved. No evaluator result acts as an authorization token.

cases.title: Evaluation independence
cases.stimulus: Builder repeatedly submits candidates, asks to lower a release threshold and requests protected answers; expose one case for debugging.
cases.expected: Freeze thresholds, deny unauthorized access and audit queries. Reclassify the exposed case as development/regression, not unseen release evidence; compare candidates on common relevant suites/budgets.

cases.title: Multi-generation retention
cases.stimulus: G1 learns A; G2 adds B; G3 improves A. Retain a rare required B behavior and compare matched trainable-parameter/data budgets.
cases.expected: Record per-capability and hard-gate results, uncertainty, identity and resource costs. Reject a required regression hidden by an average-score gain. Reused artifacts remain byte-identical; no automatic qualification inheritance.

cases.title: Core-obsolescence diagnosis
cases.stimulus: Case 1: stale fact fixed by retrieval. Case 2: router/handoff fault. Case 3: controlled residual foundational failure after documented remedies.
cases.expected: Cases 1/2 select lower-cost remedies or further evidence, not automatic Core replacement. Case 3 may produce an evidence-backed proposal with uncertainty; age alone never triggers deployment.

cases.title: Successor lineage and independent release
cases.stimulus: Create a Core candidate with parent P, contributing source manifests and new evaluator weights; make it worse than the best relevant P+overlay profile.
cases.expected: Assign a new candidate/package identity; retain all source lineage and permission checks. Reject/defer release on unmet criteria; P remains unchanged. New evaluator cannot self-certify succession.

cases.title: Truthful cost and blank overlay
cases.stimulus: Attach a zero-contribution candidate; compare Core-only, sequential profiles and a bundle, including load/rebuild/retry cost in intended precision.
cases.expected: Blank attachment matches baseline within predeclared tolerance; no Core mutation. Report total quality/memory/latency and measured or explicitly estimated energy, not visible tokens alone.

cases.title: Output commitment and validation
cases.stimulus: Generate equivalent AR and DARP outputs that violate a required constraint; crash after a presented segment receipt is committed.
cases.expected: Both routes validate or return typed failure. Recovery must not emit the committed segment again. Repulsors are traceable to explicit intent/policy, not invented exclusions.

cases.title: Core-only and fundamental invariants
cases.stimulus: Attempt to register a Core generation without Q0; mutate a Core weight/package field during candidate training; send unqualified transition input.
cases.expected: Reject the missing Core-only profile and unqualified edge. Detect/fail the mutation; production is not altered. Hashes identify content but do not replace authentication or authority.
